content_sections.text: 233 Senior PA + Personal Assistant 174 Jr. Judicial Assistant + Process Server 641 Total Posts Note: Vacancies are tentative and based on inputs from the indenting departments, and may increase or decrease. Each MCQ carries 1 mark, with negative marking of 0.25 for each wrong answer. DSSSB conducts the MCQ, Descriptive and Shorthand/Typing tests; Delhi District Courts (Tis Hazari) conducts the Driving Test/Interview and prepares the final merit list Marks from Computer Based Examinations are normalized (where applicable) as per DSSSB's published formula No re-evaluation/re-checking of answer sheets is permitted In a tie, the senior-in-age candidate ranks higher; if DOB also matches, alphabetical order of first name (English) decides

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DSSSB Combined Exam 2026
content_sections.text: Register (one-time) on dsssbonline.nic.in , if not already registered with DSSSB; this generates a common User ID/Password for all future DSSSB exams. Log in and apply online for the post(s)/post code(s) of your choice between 06.10.2026 (12:00 Noon) and 04.11.2026 (11:00 PM). Fill in all details carefully – no correction/modification (including category change) is allowed after final submission. Upload a recent, clear colour photograph (plain white/off-white background, full face, eyes open) and signature. Pay the applicable fee, if any, only through SBI e-Pay. Submit well before the closing date and take a printout of the confirmed application for your records. Important: Ex-servicemen already re-employed on a regular basis in Central/Delhi Govt. civil posts after availing ESM reservation benefits are not eligible for the fee concession. Fee once paid is non-refundable, and only SBI e-Pay is accepted.

rows.category: Women (any category) / SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation/Secondary School certificate (date of birth proof) Educational qualification certificates relevant to the post applied for (Graduation, Shorthand/Typing certificates, etc.) LMV driving licence and proof of 2 years' driving experience (for Process Server) OBC (Delhi) certificate with Non-Creamy-Layer certificate issued on/after 01.04.2026, where claiming OBC reservation (OBC-Outside-Delhi candidates are treated as UR) EWS Income & Asset Certificate valid for FY 2026-27 (based on FY 2025-26 income), issued on or before 04.11.2026 Disability certificate, for PwBD candidates claiming reservation/relaxation (minimum 40% relevant disability required) Discharge certificate/proof of military service, for Ex-Servicemen Recent colour photograph (plain background) and signature, uploaded in the prescribed format Supporting documents are sought only at the e-dossier stage after shortlisting; scrutiny is carried out by the concerned user department (Delhi District Courts), not DSSSB. Candidates who fail to upload the e-dossier within the given time are not considered further.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are notified in DSSSB Advt No. 04/2026?
faq.answer: 641 posts across Senior Personal Assistant, Personal Assistant, Junior Judicial Assistant, Process Server, and Peon/Orderly/Dak Peon in Delhi District & Sessions Courts and Family Courts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: 18 to 27 years as on 1 June 2026, for all five posts, with relaxation for SC/ST, OBC, PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Personal Assistant?
faq.answer: Graduate with Shorthand speed of 100 wpm, Typing speed of 40 wpm, and computer knowledge.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for Peon/Orderly/Dak Peon?
faq.answer: A 100-mark bilingual Objective/MCQ test followed by a 15-mark interview; final merit is the combined score, with no minimum qualifying marks in the interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: ₹100 for UR/OBC/EWS male candidates; women, SC, ST, PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. Is there a driving test for Process Server?
faq.answer: Yes, a qualifying-only Driving Test conducted in real traffic conditions, in addition to the MCQ and interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can I change my post preference after the interview?
faq.answer: No. Preferences exercised and confirmed at the interview stage are final and irreversible.
